verdict.rationale: The firm's own IP Litigation pages say it has more than 100 IP litigators handling patent, copyright, trademark and trade-secret cases, and a Chambers quote confirms patent, trademark and trade-secret disputes. However, venues and outcomes appear only in generic terms ("winning track record across US and global venues"), and the trademark excerpt describes prosecution and portfolio work rather than court matters. Missing for 10: specific named courts or venues (e.g., district courts, ITC, PTAB), concrete case outcomes or verdicts, trademark litigation-specific matter descriptions, and independent corroboration of results.
